title: Preparation of Primary Alveolar Epithelial Type I Cells from Mouse Lungs
author: Huang, Tang, et al.

steps.title: Discard supernatant and wash
steps.instruction: Discard the cell supernatant from the 35 mm glass‑bottom petri dish and wash the cells once with PBS buffer.

steps.title: Fix cells with paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Fix cells with freshly prepared 2 % paraformaldehyde at room temperature (RT) for 10 min, then remove the PFA and wash twice with PBS for 5 min each.

steps.title: Block cells
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with blocking buffer at RT for 1 h, then remove the blocking buffer.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute rabbit anti‑mouse AQP5 and rabbit IgG in primary‑antibody buffer to 10 µg mL⁻¹; incubate cells with the primary‑antibody solution at RT for 1 h, remove the solution, and wash three times with PBS for 5 min each.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute AF488‑conjugated donkey anti‑rabbit secondary antibody in PBS to 10 µg mL⁻¹; incubate cells with this solution at RT for 1 h protected from light, remove the solution, and wash three times with PBS for 5 min each.

steps.title: DAPI staining and mounting
steps.instruction: Dilute DAPI in PBS to 10 µg mL⁻¹; incubate cells at RT for 15 min protected from light, remove DAPI solution, wash once with PBS for 5 min, then mount cells with mounting medium and acquire images on a confocal laser‑scanning microscope.

steps.title: Harvest cultured AT1 cells
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant from the 24‑well plate, wash cells once with PBS, add Trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 2 min at 37 °C, add AT1 medium to stop digestion, gently pipette, transfer the suspension to a 15 mL tube, centrifuge at 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Fix cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL fresh 2 % paraformaldehyde, incubate at RT for 10 min; centrifuge at 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in FACS buffer, and centrifuge again at 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL permeabilization buffer containing Tween 20, incubate at RT for 10 min; centrifuge at 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash cells twice
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice by resuspending in FACS buffer, centrifuging at 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C each time, and discarding the supernatant after each spin.

steps.title: Block cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in blocking buffer, incubate at RT for 30 min in the dark; centrifuge at 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Primary antibody staining (flow)
steps.instruction: Dilute rabbit anti‑mouse RAGE or Syrian hamster anti‑mouse podoplanin (and respective IgG controls) in FACS buffer to 10 µg mL⁻¹; resuspend cells with the primary‑antibody solution and incubate 1 h at RT protected from light, add 1 mL FACS buffer, centrifuge at 200 g for 5 min at 4 °C, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Secondary antibody staining (flow)
steps.instruction: Dilute AF488‑conjugated donkey anti‑rabbit and CY3‑conjugated goat anti‑Syrian hamster antibodies in 1× PBS to 20 µg mL⁻¹; resuspend cells with the secondary‑antibody mixture, incubate 30 min at RT protected from light, then add 400 µL PBS to each tube.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Proceed to detection on the flow cytometer.
